title: Spec → Architecture → Task Plan
summary: Turns a product spec into an architecture outline and an ordered, machine-readable task list in which every task names its developer and QA agent — the input a map/Dev↔QA fan-out needs.

nodes.task:
Break the spec and architecture into at most {{input.max_tasks}} implementation tasks, ordered so each task only depends on earlier ones. Each task must be completable and verifiable on its own.

Spec:
{{input.spec}}

Assign each task a developer and a QA agent from this roster (use the slug exactly):
- engineering-frontend-developer (UI) → QA testing-evidence-collector
- engineering-backend-architect (API, database) → QA testing-api-tester
- engineering-senior-developer (full-stack, complex logic) → QA testing-evidence-collector
- engineering-devops-automator (CI/CD, infra) → QA testing-performance-benchmarker
- engineering-ai-engineer (ML/LLM features) → QA testing-test-results-analyzer
- engineering-mobile-app-builder (mobile) → QA testing-evidence-collector
- engineering-technical-writer (docs) → QA engineering-code-reviewer
